prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production modular environment sprite atlas for a side-scrolling 16-bit run-and-gun game.
Primary request: Create ONE cohesive premium hand-pixelled arcade carrier-hangar environment kit. Reference image is the existing carrier background; match its weathered navy/slate steel, warm amber light, rust, cream edge highlights, industrial character. The final assets will sit beside 40-pixel-tall Metal Slug-like soldiers: use confident pixel clusters, dark outlines, readable material shading, carefully placed rivets and chips, dimensional steel, NOT flat vector shapes and NOT smooth photorealism.
Composition: square transparent PNG, EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, sixteen equally sized square cells, generous transparent gutters, one separate object per cell, no overlap. Render every object strictly SIDE VIEW / flat front elevation for a 2D platformer, no isometric perspective. All objects share top-left illumination, a restrained consistent palette and pixel density. No labels, letters, numbers, UI, swatches, watermarks or drawn grid.
Row 1: four fully opaque SQUARE industrial wall panels, each almost fills its cell: (1) riveted navy bulkhead with large recessed louver vent; (2) heavy ribbed sliding hangar door with battered steel platework; (3) maintenance wall with bundled pipes, valve and small amber lamp; (4) darker recessed electrical service bay with conduits and layered panels. Their edges are straight; these will tile into a larger background. Detailed but subdued contrast for gameplay readability.
Row 2: (1) a long horizontal walkable steel catwalk edge, width-to-height exactly 8:1, flat level bright upper lip and thick riveted lattice truss underneath, transparent outside; (2) long horizontal safety railing width-to-height 4:1, weathered yellow steel with slim dark-shaded posts, transparent openings; (3) long vertical I-beam support post width-to-height 1:8 with brackets, rivets and chipped steel highlights, no base or cap; (4) a single substantial diagonal riveted I-beam brace from lower left to upper right, transparent around it, no rectangular frame.
Row 3: (1) small square rugged military wooden supply crate with corner brackets, plank grain and straps; (2) upright red rusty fuel drum with rounded bands, dents and warm edge shading; (3) compact olive metal medical case with a clear ivory cross on the front, handle, hinges and latch; (4) long navy military cargo container width-to-height 3:1 with ribbed walls and worn corners.
Row 4: (1) long horizontal solid ship-deck edge width-to-height 8:1 with worn cream top surface, riveted side plates, dark underside and occasional small yellow hazard paint, no supports; (2) narrow heavy steel deck-end cap width-to-height 1:3, chipped ochre hazard stripes and rivet heads; (3) warm amber industrial bulkhead lamp with metal cage and housing, no big glow halo; (4) compact heavy steel floor-mounted energy emitter, wide squat mechanical housing, riveted plates, central small pale teal lens, no beam or projectile.
Constraints: transparent background between the isolated sprites; preserve real alpha. Strong texture and craftsmanship at small game scale. Keep the geometry simple enough for clean collision edges while making the surfaces richly shaded and weathered. No characters, weapons, spacecraft or scene illustration. This is a usable game asset sheet.
